method: Read-only gh issue list --repo lambdaclass/stabileo --state open --limit 2000 --json number,title,labels,body; static applicability review of every frozen input/output and the slab builder against open issue descriptions and nightly reproducer features. No claim of independently proving every retained result.

cases.reason: Flat, regular square quads with transverse nodal loads; no curved roof/cylinder (#810), distorted in-plane bending (#798), warped geometry (#1057), member-end hinges, connectors, combinations or imposed displacements. The recorded output is the gallery readout and field, not a general shell accuracy claim. The shell-stress rotation candidates #1898/#1823/#1816/#1813 concern rotated pressure/self-weight strips and stress components not recorded by these unrotated slab readouts.
